'''Ralo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] in the [[Republic Army]].

==Biography==
In [[3636 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|4.0}}</ref> Ralo participated in [[Darth Marr]]'s [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Destruction of Darth Marr's flagship|expedition]], serving aboard the fleet's flagship. The task was ambushed by the [[Eternal Fleet]], which launched boarding pods containing [[skytrooper]]s. While fighting to hold his section, Ralo had a brief encounter with the galactic hero known as [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]]. Eventually, Ralo was forced to abandon ship as Marr's flagship was destroyed.<ref name="Chapter 1">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=1}}</ref>

At some point after this disastrous battle, Ralo joined [[Koth Vortena]]'s crew of misfits, eventually taking refuge on the [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] of [[Asylum]]. He would later reunite with the Outlander five years after the [[Eternal Empire]]'s [[Eternal Empire conquest|conquest]], when the latter, along with Koth, [[Lana Beniko]], [[HK-55]], and [[Senya Tirall]] arrived in the ''[[Gravestone]]''. Later on, he joined the crew in storming the [[Scions of Zakuul|Scions']] hideout.<ref name="Chapter 6">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=6}}</ref>

When the Eternal Empire later [[Battle of Asylum|invaded]] Asylum, Ralo stood by his crewmates as they defended the ''Gravestone'' before evacuating.<ref name="Chapter 8">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=8}}</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Ralo is a character in the Digital Expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']] for the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. He first appears in '''Chapter I: The Hunt'''.

===Gameplay alternatives===
In '''Chapter I: The Hunt''', the player must choose whether to save a group of besieged troopers in the hangar, and later must choose whether to issue an evacuation order or ram the Eternal Fleet. Ralo will comment on the player's decisions at these events upon meeting them in '''Chapter VI: Asylum'''.

In '''Chapter X: Anarchy in Paradise''', Ralo will leave the [[Eternal Alliance]] alongside [[Len Parvek]] and [[Koth Vortena]]. Note that this event is determined by the player's choices in regard to ''Koth'' (i.e., allowing the sun generator to go critical and being complicit in [[Kaliyo Djannis|Kaliyo's]] bombings) and not Ralo.
